name: Rod of the General
body:
Price 25,000 gp; Aura strong conjuration, transmutation, and divination; CL 12; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This gilded rod is in shining metal, usual mithral, and banded in gold. The possessor gains a +2 enhancement bonus to their leadership score while the rod is held or carried. Additionally, the bearer can prepare an additional aura from the marshal class.

Additionally, once per day, the rod can create a 30-foot radius command tent. The inside of the tent is furnished as a military command post. The tent provides protection from harsh weather and temperatures. The tent lasts for 24 hours at which point it disappears with any objects left within the tent. The objects left within are restored when the tent is summoned again.

Additionally, once per week, the tent can be summoned with a detailed map of the 10-mile radius around the tent. This map cannot be removed from the tent and disappears when the tent does.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 12,500 gp; Feats Craft Rod; Spells eagle’s splendor, major creation, scry
